_doc: Manual overlay for the generated coverage map (bank/coverage.py). Data alone shows what we HAVE; this file records what we KNOW we are missing and why, plus the shared state vocabularies. Generated counts always win for presence; these notes annotate intent and gaps.

notes.note: Our sourced phoneme key is Akuapem (Christaller). Asante needs its own source. The GhanaNLP twi-g2p we use leans Asante, so tool and inventory currently disagree — reconcile. Find a permissive Asante phonology description.
Affix paradigms are Akuapem (Christaller §54). Asante forms differ in places; need an Asante grammar source or to extract Asante-marked variants.
Covered only by attributed (not attested) wordforms; no Asante-attested glossed lexicon yet.
Khaya/GhanaNLP TTS+ASR and radio available but NOT yet ingested/scored. Bridge: synthesize from the (Akuapem) phoneme key until an Asante source lands.
Thin. Some church/radio audio exists; not sourced.
Only variant-deltas from Christaller so far (ts/dz, a few entries). No standalone Fante lexicon.
No Somali records yet. Standardized Latin orthography means less reliance on scanned-grammar re-OCR; broadcast audio is abundant. First expansion target for the Abdi demo.
